structure.unit: Highways and Other Surface Transportation Systems
Interstate 81 Corridor Improvement Program and Fund

text.section:
The Board shall adopt an Interstate 81 Corridor Improvement Program. The Program shall, at a minimum:
Allocate year by year the revenues, if any, from the Fund and bond proceeds, if any, backed by the Fund to projects and strategies identified in the Plan adopted by the Board;
Include a financing plan to support such allocation; and
Include a schedule for all new projects and strategies identified in the Plan adopted by the Board.
Prior to the adoption of such Program, the Board shall review the recommendations of and consult with the Committee.
The Board shall update the Program annually by July 1.
